paper_title: Constraining Ultralight Dark Matter through an Accelerated Resonant Search
notes: Paper (ChangE-NMR, K-Rb-21Ne magnetometer in Fermi-contact enhanced NMR mode) sets new 95% CL limits on both gann (neutron) and gapp (proton) couplings over 4.5-15.5 Hz Compton frequency (~1.9e-14 to 6.4e-14 eV). No numerical table is provided in the extracted content (full dataset referenced at [47]); data points are approximate readings of the bin-averaged (black) limit curve from Fig. 3, with masses converted via m[eV]=4.136e-15*f[Hz]. Limits surpass neutron-star cooling bounds in 4.6-6.6 Hz and near 7.5 Hz. Local DM density rho=0.4 GeV/cm^3 explicitly assumed. Proton coupling gapp limits (roughly ~10x weaker, since xi_p=0.04 vs xi_n=0.58 in 21Ne) also available but AxionNeutron chosen as primary per dominant sensitivity.
